description: Negative: raw HL7 v3 NullFlavor code written straight into cascade:dataAbsentReason
shaclConstraintViolated: cascade:DataAbsentReasonShape binds cascade:dataAbsentReason with sh:in to the 15 codes of http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/data-absent-reason. 'UNK' is not among them.
notes: UNK is a real code, but it belongs to HL7 v3 NullFlavor, not to the data-absent-reason code system cascade:dataAbsentReason is bound to. An importer maps nullFlavor on the way in (the mapping table is stated on the property in core.ttl: UNK -> unknown). Accepting both spellings would give every absence two encodings and turn 'is this the same absence?' into a string-comparison question. Measured RED against the pre-train spec pin, where the predicate had no shape at all and this record raised nothing.
